name: Omron Platinum Blood Pressure Monitor BP5450
description: Upper arm blood pressure monitor with dual-display and TruRead technology that automatically takes three consecutive readings. Stores up to 200 readings for two users with Bluetooth connectivity for remote monitoring.

name: Zacurate Pro Series 500DL Fingertip Pulse Oximeter
description: Clinical-grade fingertip pulse oximeter with OLED display showing SpO2 and pulse rate. Designed for spot-check monitoring in pharmacy and home health settings.

name: OneTouch Verio Reflect Blood Glucose Monitor System
description: Blood glucose monitoring system with color-coded range indicator and Bluetooth sync to the OneTouch Reveal app. Provides pattern recognition to help patients and clinicians identify trends.

name: FreeStyle Libre 3 CGM Sensor Kit
description: Continuous glucose monitoring sensor providing real-time glucose readings every minute without fingerstick calibration. Each sensor lasts 14 days with smartphone-based alerts for high and low glucose.

name: Philips InnoSpire Elegance Compressor Nebulizer
description: Compact tabletop compressor nebulizer for aerosol drug delivery in respiratory patients. Quiet operation suitable for home use with adult and pediatric masks included.

specs.includes: Adult mask, pediatric mask, tubing, mouthpiece

name: TENS 7000 Digital TENS Unit with Accessories
description: Dual-channel digital TENS unit for pain management with adjustable pulse width, rate, and intensity. FDA-cleared for over-the-counter use in treating chronic and acute pain.

name: Braun ThermoScan 7+ Digital Ear Thermometer
description: Professional-grade tympanic thermometer with Age Precision technology and color-coded fever guidance. Pre-warmed tip ensures accurate readings in clinical and home settings.

name: Withings Body Comp Wi-Fi Smart Scale
description: Medical-grade connected body composition scale measuring weight, body fat, muscle mass, bone mass, and body water. Syncs to health platforms for remote patient monitoring programs.

specs.measurements: Weight, BMI, body fat %, water %, muscle mass, bone mass

name: Vive Health Rechargeable Portable Nebulizer
description: Handheld mesh nebulizer for on-the-go respiratory treatments. USB-C rechargeable with silent vibrating mesh technology, suitable for both children and adults.

name: Bioland RPM Gateway + Blood Pressure Bundle
description: Remote patient monitoring bundle with cellular gateway hub, Bluetooth blood pressure cuff, and pulse oximeter. Data auto-transmits to clinic dashboards for chronic care management programs.

name: Drive Medical Nitro Euro Style Rollator Walker
description: Lightweight aluminum rollator with European-style design, cross-brace frame, and built-in seat with backrest. Features 10-inch front casters for indoor and outdoor use.

name: Vive Health Folding Steel Walker with Wheels
description: Standard two-button folding walker with 5-inch front wheels and rear glide caps. Height-adjustable legs accommodate users from 5'4" to 6'2" with a 300 lb weight capacity.

name: Medline Lightweight Transport Wheelchair
description: Compact 19 lb transport chair with 12-inch rear wheels and swing-away footrests. Nylon upholstery with desk-length armrests, designed for caregiver-assisted mobility.

name: Drive Medical Silver Sport 2 Wheelchair
description: Dual-axle manual wheelchair with quick-release 24-inch rear wheels and padded armrests. Chrome-plated steel frame with embossed vinyl upholstery for durability in high-use clinical settings.

name: KneeRover Economy Knee Walker Scooter
description: Steerable knee scooter for lower leg injuries as a crutch alternative. Features adjustable knee pad height, dual rear brakes, and a front basket for personal items.

name: Vive Health Adjustable Bath Bench with Back
description: Lightweight aluminum shower bench with drainage holes and non-slip rubber feet. Tool-free assembly with adjustable height legs and a contoured seat for comfort and stability.

name: Drive Medical Padded Shower Chair with Armrests
description: Heavy-duty shower chair with padded seat and armrests for patient comfort. Corrosion-resistant aluminum frame with drainage holes and suction-tip legs for wet surface safety.

name: Carex Raised Toilet Seat with Handles
description: Elevated toilet seat adding 3.5 inches of height with padded locking armrests. Universal fit for standard and elongated bowls, reducing strain for patients with hip or knee limitations.

name: Vive Health Chrome Grab Bar 18-Inch
description: ADA-compliant wall-mounted grab bar for bathroom safety. Chrome-plated steel with concealed flanges and textured grip surface for secure hold in wet conditions.

name: Medline Assist Bed Rail with Storage Pocket
description: Adjustable height bed assist rail that slides between mattress and box spring for secure installation. Features an integrated storage pocket and padded grip handle for safe transfers.

name: ResMed AirSense 11 AutoSet CPAP Machine
description: Auto-adjusting CPAP device with integrated humidifier and quiet motor for sleep apnea therapy. Features personal therapy assistant, nightly sleep score, and cloud-connected data reporting for clinician monitoring.

name: Inogen One G5 Portable Oxygen Concentrator
description: Lightweight portable oxygen concentrator delivering up to 6 pulse-dose settings for ambulatory patients. FAA-approved for air travel with long-lasting battery options up to 13 hours.

name: Philips Respironics DreamStation 2 BiPAP Auto
description: Auto-adjusting bilevel positive airway pressure device for complex sleep apnea and respiratory insufficiency. Integrated heated humidifier with advanced event detection and DreamMapper app connectivity.

name: ResMed AirFit F30i Full Face CPAP Mask
description: Top-of-head tube connection full face mask for unrestricted sleep positioning. Minimal-contact cushion design reduces facial pressure marks with magnetic clips for easy on/off.

name: DeVilbiss Suction Machine 7305 Series
description: Portable suction unit for airway clearance in home health and clinical settings. Provides continuous and intermittent suction with adjustable vacuum regulation up to 560 mmHg.

name: Compat Ella Enteral Feeding Pump
description: Programmable enteral feeding pump for tube-fed patients in home and facility settings. Supports continuous, intermittent, and bolus delivery modes with occlusion and empty-bag alarms.

specs.alarms: Occlusion, empty bag, low battery, system error

name: Roho Dry Flotation Pressure Relief Wheelchair Cushion
description: Air-cell pressure redistribution cushion for wheelchair-bound patients at risk for pressure injuries. Individually adjustable air cells conform to body contours, reducing peak pressure and shear forces.

name: Drive Medical Alternating Pressure Mattress Pad System
description: Alternating pressure pad with variable-cycle pump for hospital bed pressure injury prevention. Fits standard hospital mattresses with adjustable comfort settings and low-pressure alarm.

name: Hoyer Advance Hydraulic Patient Lift
description: Manual hydraulic patient lift for safe seated and supine transfers. Six-point spreader bar with 360-degree rotation accommodates standard and bariatric slings for caregiver-assisted transfers.

name: Philips IntelliVue MX450 Patient Monitor
description: Multi-parameter bedside monitoring platform tracking ECG, SpO2, NIBP, temperature, and capnography. Touchscreen display with alarm management and HL7 integration for hospital information systems.

specs.parameters: ECG, SpO2, NIBP, Temp, EtCO2, IBP

name: GE Venue Go Portable Ultrasound System
description: Compact point-of-care ultrasound with 12-inch touchscreen and advanced imaging modes. Portable design supports emergency, critical care, and musculoskeletal applications with DICOM connectivity.

specs.imaging_modes: B-Mode, M-Mode, Color Doppler, PW Doppler

name: Midmark 630 Barrier-Free Power Examination Table
description: ADA-compliant power examination table with low height access for wheelchair transfers. Programmable positions for routine exams, procedures, and barrier-free patient access.

name: OEC Elite MiniView C-Arm Fluoroscopy System
description: Compact mobile C-arm for orthopedic, vascular, and pain management procedures. High-resolution flat panel detector with low-dose imaging and touchscreen workflow controls.

name: GE Carestation 750 Anesthesia System
description: Advanced anesthesia workstation with integrated ventilator and electronic gas mixing for surgical environments. Supports volume, pressure, and spontaneous ventilation modes with compliance monitoring.

name: Hausmann 1392 Parallel Bars – Wall Mounted
description: Wall-mounted parallel bars for physical therapy gait training in clinics and rehab facilities. Heavy-gauge steel construction with adjustable height and width to accommodate diverse patient populations.

name: Clinton 8570 Multi-Use Hi-Lo Treatment Table
description: Electric hi-lo treatment table for physical therapy and rehabilitation. Power height adjustment with manual backrest positioning, 600 lb capacity, and durable laminate base with nosedrop section.
